monuments and sculpture in a chronological order:

(B) Alexander Cunningham published Bhilsā Topes, one of the earliest
works on Sanchi.
(C) Rajendra Lala Mitra published Buddha Gaya: The Heritage of Sakya

detailedSolution:

Thus, the correct chronological sequence is (D) -> (B) -> (C) -> (A).
